inputs.text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued it burdened religious freedom. That framing deserves suspicion: institutions are turning religious liberty into a tool to protect abortion, while casting limits on it as oppression. The headline makes the inversion plain—what should be a debate about ending unborn lives is being repackaged as a right the system must defend.
